integrity: Self-contained analytical proof with numerical reproducibility checks; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact first moments only; diagonal diffusion, fixed step and frozen Metzler drift; acyclic three-site chain. General matrix embeddability is established prior theory and is not claimed new. Priority relative to classical embedding literature remains uncertain.
title: The variance-midpoint boundary for positive exact-mean drift calibration on a three-site stochastic chain
